title: The regressor lets go of Dokja over a sea serpent, and the beast swallows him whole . . . (highlight)

segments.say: The regressor lets go of Dokja over a sea serpent, and the beast *swallows* him whole.
He cuts through the dead like they are nothing, then grabs Dokja by the *throat*.
He wants one thing. A name. Dokja Kim, comes the answer, and the stranger says what a strange *name*.
But Dokja knows exactly who this is. Junghyeok Yu, the *regressor*, the most dangerous man in the whole story.
So Dokja tells the scariest guy alive he is older, so he should show some *respect*. Absolute madman energy.
A message pops up. Junghyeok has become *cautious* of you. Dokja just made the regressor nervous.
Then Dokja admits he is a fan. He read all three thousand episodes of Junghyeok's *journey*. He liked him, hated him, and cheered for him.
Junghyeok does not care. He will forgive the attitude, but he has one question. How did Dokja survive the *subway*?
If I tell you, will you let me live? Junghyeok says that depends on the *answer*.
So Dokja lies a little. He got lucky, he says, because he spotted the kid with the insects when the explosion made him *fall*.
Junghyeok does not buy it. A newbie this calm must have killed Namwoon Kim, which makes him useful, and very *dangerous*.
Dokja asks to be let go, because they are running out of time. Junghyeok says not so *fast*.
He uses his Eye of the Sage to read Dokja's stats, and Dokja's Fourth Wall *blocks* it.
Now Junghyeok is squeezing his neck and asking what the hell this guy *is*.
The full story is on our channel.
